```{r}
center_rate <- 0.5

seed_start <- 0
tau_seq <- seq(0, 100, 0.5)
time_col <- "time"
status_col <- "status"
stan_iter <- 2000
stan_warmup <- 1000

coverage_rate_list <- vector("list", length(p_list))

for (p_i in seq_along(p_list)) {
  p <- p_list[[p_i]]
  cat("\n\n n = ", n, "; p = ", p)

  approaches <- list(
    # "MPLE" = list(

    # "Post$.$ Mode: CRE \\\\ ($\\tau = p$)" = list(
    #   cat_cox,

    # ),
    # "Post$.$ Mode: WME \\\\ ($\\tau = p$)" = list(

    #   list(
    #     method = "WME",
    #     tau = p
    #   )
    # ),
    "Post$.$ Mode: CRE \\\\ (Cross-Validation)" = list(
      cat_cox_tune,
      list(
        method = "CRE",
        tau_seq = tau_seq
      )
    ),
    "Post$.$ Mode: WME \\\\ (Cross-Validation)" = list(
      cat_cox_tune,
      list(
        method = "WME",
        tau_seq = tau_seq
      )
    ),
    "Post$.$ Mean \\\\ ($\\tau = p$)" = list(

      )

      list(

      )
    )
  )

  all_sim_list <- vector("list", sim_times)

    true_coefs <- data_list$true_coefs
    entry_points <- rep(0, n)

    coverage_rate_list[[p_i]] <- c(coverage_rate_list[[p_i]], mean(train_data$status))
    # Calculate MPLE (Marginal Partial Likelihood Estimate) prediction DEV with true coefficients
    MPLE_0 <- get_cox_partial_likelihood(
      X = test_data[
        ,
        !(colnames(test_data) %in% c(
          "time", "status"
        ))
      ],
      time = test_data$time,
      status = test_data$status,
      coefs = true_coefs,
      entry_points = entry_points
    )

    all_sim_list[[sim_t]] <- cox_run_simulation(
      train_data = train_data,
      test_data = test_data,
      syn_size = 10 * p,
      entry_points = entry_points,
      approaches = approaches,
      MPLE_0 = MPLE_0,
      true_coefs = true_coefs
    )
  }
  all_p_list[[p_i]] <- all_sim_list
}

result_df <- create_cox_df_table(all_p_list)
```

```{r}
# Function to format a single row for LaTeX output
format_row_multiple <- function(df_list, index) {
  mse_means <- sapply(df_list, function(df) round(df$DEV_MEAN[index], 3))
  mse_ses <- sapply(df_list, function(df) round(df$DEV_SE[index], 3))
  sse_means <- sapply(df_list, function(df) round(df$SSE_MEAN[index], 3))
  sse_ses <- sapply(df_list, function(df) round(df$SSE_SE[index], 3))

  # Function to format numbers into scientific notation

  format_sci <- function(x) {
    if (is.nan(x) | is.na(x)) {
      return("-")
    } else if (abs(x) >= 1e10 || abs(x) < 1e-3) {
      base <- formatC(x, format = "e", digits = 3)
      base_parts <- strsplit(base, "e")[[1]]
      base_parts[2] <- sub("\\+", "", base_parts[2])
      return(paste0(
        "$",
        base_parts[1],
        " \\times 10^{",
        base_parts[2],
        "}$"
      ))
    } else {
      return(return(formatC(round(x, 3), format = "f", digits = 3)))
    }
  }

  # Apply the formatting function to each mean and standard error
  mse_means_formatted <- sapply(mse_means, format_sci)
  mse_ses_formatted <- sapply(mse_ses, format_sci)
  sse_means_formatted <- sapply(sse_means, format_sci)
  sse_ses_formatted <- sapply(sse_ses, format_sci)

  # Create one row for LaTeX combining values across dataframes for each approach
  paste0(
    "\\makecell{", df_list[[1]]$Approaches[index], "} & ",
    "\\makecell{", mse_means_formatted[1], " \\\\ \\small{(", mse_ses_formatted[1], ")}} & ",
    "\\makecell{", sse_means_formatted[1], " \\\\ \\small{(", sse_ses_formatted[1], ")}} & ",
    "\\makecell{", mse_means_formatted[2], " \\\\ \\small{(", mse_ses_formatted[2], ")}} & ",
    "\\makecell{", sse_means_formatted[2], " \\\\ \\small{(", sse_ses_formatted[2], ")}} & "
    # "\\makecell{", mse_means_formatted[3], " \\\\ \\small{(", mse_ses_formatted[3], ")}} & ",
    # "\\makecell{", sse_means_formatted[3], " \\\\ \\small{(", sse_ses_formatted[3], ")}} \\\\ ",
    # "\\addlinespace"
  )
}

# Function to format the entire table for all approaches
generate_latex_table_multiple <- function(df_list) {
  n <- nrow(df_list[[1]]) # Assuming all dataframes have the same number of rows
  latex_rows <- sapply(1:n, function(i) format_row_multiple(df_list, i))
  return(latex_rows)
}

create_cox_df_table <- function(all_p_list) {
  result_df <- vector("list", length(all_p_list[[1]]))

  apps <- all_p_list[[1]][[1]]$Approaches

  for (s in seq_along(all_p_list)) {
    add_to_result_df <- data.frame(
      Approaches = apps,
      DEV_MEAN = numeric(length(apps)),
      DEV_SE = numeric(length(apps)),
      SSE_MEAN = numeric(length(apps)),
      SSE_SE = numeric(length(apps))
    )

    dev_values <- sapply(all_p_list[[s]], function(sim) sim$DEV)
    sse_values <- sapply(all_p_list[[s]], function(sim) sim$SSE)

    add_to_result_df$DEV_MEAN <- apply(dev_values, 1, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
    add_to_result_df$DEV_SE <- apply(dev_values, 1, function(vs) {
      n <- sum(!is.na(vs)) # Count of non-NA values
      if (n > 1) {
        sd(vs, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n) # Standard error
      } else {
        NA # Return NA if there are not enough values
      }
    })
    add_to_result_df$SSE_MEAN <- apply(sse_values, 1, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
    add_to_result_df$SSE_SE <- apply(sse_values, 1, function(vs) {
      n <- sum(!is.na(vs)) # Count of non-NA values
      if (n > 1) {
        sd(vs, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n) # Standard error
      } else {
        NA # Return NA if there are not enough values
      }
    })
    result_df[[s]] <- add_to_result_df
  }
  return(result_df)
}

cox_run_simulation <- function(train_data,
                               test_data,
                               MPLE_0,
                               approaches,
                               syn_size,
                               true_coefs,
                               entry_points) {
  out_df <- data.frame(
    Approaches = names(approaches),
    DEV = numeric(length(approaches)),
    SSE = numeric(length(approaches))
  )

  stand_input <- list(
    formula = survival::Surv(time, status) ~ .
  )

  cat_init <- cat_cox_initialization(
    formula = survival::Surv(time, status) ~ 1,
    data = train_data,
    syn_size = syn_size,
    entry_points = entry_points
  )

  for (app_i in seq_along(approaches)) {
    cat("\n\n", names(approaches)[app_i])

    model_input <- if (names(approaches)[app_i] == "MPLE") {
      c(
        stand_input,
        approaches[[app_i]][[2]],
        list(
          data = train_data
        )
      )
    } else {
      c(
        stand_input,
        approaches[[app_i]][[2]],
        list(cat_init = cat_init)
      )
    }
    app_model <- do.call(approaches[[app_i]][[1]], model_input)

    out_df[app_i, "DEV"] <- MPLE_0 -
      get_cox_partial_likelihood(
        X = test_data[
          ,
          !(colnames(test_data) %in% c(
            "time", "status"
          ))
        ],
        time = test_data$time,
        status = test_data$status,
        coefs = coef(app_model),
        entry_points = entry_points
      )

    out_df[app_i, "SSE"] <- as.numeric(sum(
      (coef(app_model) - true_coefs)^2
    ))
  }

  return(out_df)
}

truncated_rnorm <- function(n, mean = 0, sd = 1, min = -Inf, max = Inf) {
  # Initialize an empty vector to store the samples
  samples <- numeric(n)

  # Continue sampling until we have enough values in the desired range
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    repeat {
      # Draw from the normal distribution
      sample <- rnorm(1, mean = mean, sd = sd)

      # Check if the sample is within the desired range
      if (sample >= min & sample <= max) {
        samples[i] <- sample
        break
      }
    }
  }

  return(samples)
}


cox_data_genaration <- function(n,
                                p,
                                n_test,
                                lambda = 1,
                                censor_rate = 0.8) {
  true_coefs <- rnorm(p)

  x <- matrix(rnorm((n + n_test) * p), ncol = p)

  # Choose half of the cols to be binomial and gamma
  to_change_cols <- sample(1:p, as.integer(p / 2))

  binomial_cols <- to_change_cols[
    1:(length(to_change_cols) / 2)
  ]

  chi_square_cols <- to_change_cols[
    (length(to_change_cols) / 2 + 1):length(to_change_cols)
  ]


  for (col in binomial_cols) {
    x[, col] <- rbinom((n + n_test), 1, runif(1, 0.25, 0.75))
  }

  for (col in chi_square_cols) {
    x[, col] <- rgamma((n + n_test),
      shape = runif(1, 1, 5),
      rate = runif(1, 1, 5)
    )
  }

  # Calculate linear predictor eta
  eta <- x %*% true_coefs

  # Baseline hazard rate
  lambda <- lambda

  # Simulate event times from an exponential distribution
  event_time <- rexp((n + n_test), rate = (lambda * exp(eta)))

  # Simulate censoring times (uniformly distributed)
  censor_time <- runif((n + n_test),
    min = 0,
    max = quantile(
      event_time,
      censor_rate
    )
  )

  # observed time is the minimum of event or censoring time
  time <- pmin(event_time, censor_time)

  # event occurred if T <= C, otherwise censored
  status <- as.numeric(event_time <= censor_time)

  names(x) <- c(paste0("X", 1:p))

  train_data <- data.frame(
    time = time[1:n],
    status = status[1:n],
    x[1:n, ]
  )

  test_data <- data.frame(
    time = time[(n + 1):(n + n_test)],
    status = status[(n + 1):(n + n_test)],
    x[(n + 1):(n + n_test), ]
  )

  return(list(
    train_data = train_data,
    test_data = test_data,
    true_coefs = true_coefs
  ))
}
```

```{r}
# GLM Binomial
# Setting
n_list <- c(52, 39, 26)
p <- 13

sim_times <- 5
seed_start <- 0
tau_seq <- seq(0.5, 100, 0.5)
test_method <- c("DEV Mean\n(SE)")
data_Y_name <- "empyr1"
stan_multi <- 10000

data("swim")
swim_data <- cbind(swim$x, swim$y)
all_n_error_list <- vector("list", length(n_list))

for (n_i in seq_along(n_list)) {
  n <- n_list[n_i]

  cat("\n n = ", n, "; p = ", p)

  stan_iter <- as.integer((p / n) * stan_multi)
  stan_warmup <- as.integer(stan_iter / 2)

  approaches <- list(
    "MLE" = list(
      stats::glm,
      list()
    ),
    "Post$.$ Mode \\\\ ($\\tau = p$)" = list(
      cat_glm,
      list(tau = p)
    ),
    "Post$.$ Mode \\\\ (Bootstrap)" = list(
      cat_glm_tune,
      list(
        risk_estimate_method = "parametric_bootstrap",
        tau_seq = tau_seq
      )
    ),
    "Post$.$ Mode \\\\ (Steinian)" = list(
      cat_glm_tune,
      list(
        risk_estimate_method = "steinian_estimate",
        tau_seq = tau_seq
      )
    ),
    "Post$.$ Mode \\\\ (Cross-Validation)" = list(
      cat_glm_tune,
      list(
        risk_estimate_method = "cross_validation",
        tau_seq = tau_seq
      )
    ),
    "Post$.$ Mean \\\\ ($\\tau = p$)" = list(
      cat_glm_bayes,
      list(
        tau = p,
        refresh = 0,
        stan_iter = stan_iter,
        stan_warmup = stan_warmup
      )
    ),
    "Post$.$ Mean \\\\ (Joint $\\tau$ - $\\tau \\geq 0$)" = list(
      cat_glm_bayes_joint,
      list(
        refresh = 0,
        binomial_tau_lower = 0,
        stan_iter = stan_iter,
        stan_warmup = stan_warmup
      )
    ),
    "Post$.$ Mean \\\\ (Joint $\\tau$ - $\\tau \\geq 0.1$)" = list(
      cat_glm_bayes_joint,
      list(
        refresh = 0,
        binomial_tau_lower = 0.1,
        stan_iter = stan_iter,
        stan_warmup = stan_warmup
      )
    ),
    "Post$.$ Mean \\\\ (Joint $\\theta$)" = list(
      cat_glm_bayes_joint,
      list(
        refresh = 0,
        binomial_joint_theta = TRUE,
        stan_iter = stan_iter,
        stan_warmup = stan_warmup
      )
    ),
    "Post$.$ Mean \\\\ (Joint $\\theta$ \\& $\\alpha$)" = list(
      cat_glm_bayes_joint,
      list(
        refresh = 0,
        binomial_joint_theta = TRUE,
        binomial_joint_alpha = TRUE,
        stan_iter = stan_iter,
        stan_warmup = stan_warmup
      )
    ),
    "Gibbs Sampling" = list(
      cat_glm_bayes_joint_gibbs,
      list(
        refresh = FALSE,
        gibbs_iter = stan_iter,
        gibbs_warmup = stan_warmup
      )
    )
  )

  all_sim_error_list <- vector("list", sim_times)

  # Simulation
  for (sim_t in seq(1, sim_times)) {
    cat("\n\n Simulation times:", sim_t)
    set.seed(sim_t + seed_start)

    # Data Generation
    data <- logistic_reg_data_generation(
      swim_data = swim_data,
      n = n
    )

    train_data <- data$train_data
    test_data <- data$test_data

    all_sim_error_list[[sim_t]] <- logistic_reg_run_simulation(
      train_data = train_data,
      test_data = test_data,
      data_Y_name = data_Y_name,
      syn_size = 10 * p,
      approaches = approaches
    )
  }
  all_n_error_list[[n_i]] <- all_sim_error_list
}

create_reminder("Job Done")

result_df <- create_df_table(all_n_error_list)

latex_output <- generate_latex_table_multiple(result_df)
```

```{r}
# Logistic

create_df_table <- function(all_error_list) {
  result_df <- vector("list", length(all_error_list))

  apps <- all_error_list[[1]][[1]]$Approaches

  for (tbls_i in seq_along(all_error_list)) {
    add_to_result_df <- data.frame(
      Approaches = apps,
      DEV_MEAN = numeric(length(apps)),
      DEV_SE = numeric(length(apps))
    )
    tbls <- all_error_list[[tbls_i]]

    for (i in seq_along(approaches)) {
      # Extract MSE and SSE for the current approach across all simulations
      dev_values <- sapply(tbls, function(df) df$DEV[i])

      # Calculate means and standard errors
      add_to_result_df$DEV_MEAN[i] <- mean(dev_values,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )

      add_to_result_df$DEV_SE[i] <- sd(dev_values, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sim_times)
    }
    result_df[[tbls_i]] <- add_to_result_df
  }
  return(result_df)
}
# Function to format a single row for LaTeX output
format_row_multiple <- function(df_list, index) {
  dev_means <- sapply(df_list, function(df) round(df$DEV_MEAN[index], 3))
  dev_ses <- sapply(df_list, function(df) round(df$DEV_SE[index], 3))
  # sse_means <- sapply(df_list, function(df) round(df$SSE_MEAN[index], 3))
  # sse_ses <- sapply(df_list, function(df) round(df$SSE_SE[index], 3))

  # Function to format numbers into scientific notation

  format_sci <- function(x) {
    if (is.nan(x) | is.na(x)) {
      return("-")
    } else if (abs(x) >= 1e10 || abs(x) < 1e-3) {
      base <- formatC(x, format = "e", digits = 3)
      base_parts <- strsplit(base, "e")[[1]]
      base_parts[2] <- sub("\\+", "", base_parts[2])
      return(paste0(
        "$",
        base_parts[1],
        " \\times 10^{",
        base_parts[2],
        "}$"
      ))
    } else {
      return(return(formatC(round(x, 3), format = "f", digits = 3)))
    }
  }

  # Apply the formatting function to each mean and standard error
  dev_means_formatted <- sapply(dev_means, format_sci)
  dev_ses_formatted <- sapply(dev_ses, format_sci)

  # Create one row for LaTeX combining values across dataframes for each approach
  paste0(
    "\\makecell{", df_list[[1]]$Approaches[index], "} & ",
    "\\makecell{", dev_means_formatted[1], " \\\\ \\small{(", dev_ses_formatted[1], ")}} & ",
    "\\makecell{", dev_means_formatted[2], " \\\\ \\small{(", dev_ses_formatted[2], ")}} & ",
    "\\makecell{", dev_means_formatted[3], " \\\\ \\small{(", dev_ses_formatted[3], ")}} \\\\ ",
    "\\addlinespace"
  )
}


logistic_reg_run_simulation <- function(train_data,
                                        test_data,
                                        data_Y_name,
                                        family,
                                        approaches,
                                        syn_size,
                                        true_coefs) {
  out_df <- data.frame(
    Approaches = names(approaches),
    DEV = numeric(length(approaches))
  )

  stand_input <- list(
    formula = as.formula(paste0(data_Y_name, "~ ."))
  )

  cat_init <- cat_glm_initialization(
    formula = as.formula(paste0(data_Y_name, "~ 1")),
    family = binomial,
    data = train_data,
    syn_size = syn_size
  )

  for (app_i in seq_along(approaches)) {
    cat("\n\n", names(approaches)[app_i])

    model_input <- if (names(approaches)[app_i] == "MLE") {
      c(
        stand_input,
        approaches[[app_i]][[2]],
        list(
          family = binomial,
          data = train_data
        )
      )
    } else {
      c(
        stand_input,
        approaches[[app_i]][[2]],
        list(cat_init = cat_init)
      )
    }

    app_model <- do.call(approaches[[app_i]][[1]], model_input)

    if (NA %in% coef(app_model)) {
      out_df[app_i, "DEV"] <- NA
    } else {
      out_df[app_i, "DEV"] <- as.numeric(get_discrepancy(
        "logarithmic_error",
        Y = test_data[[data_Y_name]],
        est_Y = predict(app_model,
          newdata = test_data
        )
      ))
    }
  }

  return(out_df)
}


# data generation
logistic_reg_data_generation <- function(swim_data,
                                         n) {
  swim_train_idx <- sample(1:nrow(swim_data), n)

  train_data <- swim_data[swim_train_idx, ]
  test_data <- swim_data[-swim_train_idx, ]

  if (any(sapply(
    train_data,
    function(col) length(unique(col)) == 1
  ))) {
    return(logistic_reg_data_generation(swim_data, n))
  }

  return(list(
    train_data = train_data,
    test_data = test_data
  ))
}
```

```{r}
# GLM Gaussian
# Setting
devtools::load_all()
n <- 50
n_test <- 100
p_list <- c(70)

sim_times <- 2
tau_seq <- seq(0, 50, 0.5)
boots_times <- 100
stan_iter <- 2000
stan_warmup <- 1000

seed_start <- 30
data_Y_name <- "Y"

all_p_error_list <- vector("list", length(p_list))
all_model_list <- vector("list", length(p_list))
all_data_list <- vector("list", length(p_list))

for (p_i in seq_along(p_list)) {
  p <- p_list[p_i]

  cat("\n\n n = ", n, "; p = ", p)

  approaches <- list(
    "MLE" = list(
      stats::glm,
      list()
    ),
    "Post$.$ Mode \\\\ ($\\tau = p/4$)" = list(
      cat_glm,
      list(tau = p / 4)
    ),
    # "Post$.$ Mode \\\\ (Bootstrap)" = list(
    #   cat_glm_tune,
    #   list(
    #     risk_estimate_method = "parametric_bootstrap",
    #     tau_seq = tau_seq,
```

```{r}
linear_reg_run_simulation <- function(train_data,
                                      test_data,
                                      data_Y_name,
                                      family,
                                      approaches,
                                      syn_size,
                                      true_coefs,
                                      true_sigma) {
  out_df <- data.frame(
    Approaches = names(approaches),
    MSE = numeric(length(approaches)),
    SSE = numeric(length(approaches))
  )

  stand_input <- list(
    formula = as.formula(paste0(data_Y_name, "~ ."))
  )

  cat_init_custom_variance <- cat_glm_initialization(
    formula = as.formula(paste0(data_Y_name, "~ 1")),
    family = gaussian,
    data = train_data,
    syn_size = syn_size,
    custom_variance = true_sigma^2
  )

  # cat_init_known_variance <- cat_glm_initialization(
  #   formula = as.formula(paste0(data_Y_name, "~ 1")),
  #   family = gaussian,
  #   data = train_data,
  #   syn_size = syn_size,
  #   gaussian_known_variance = TRUE
  # )

  cat_init <- cat_glm_initialization(
    formula = as.formula(paste0(data_Y_name, "~ 1")),
    family = gaussian,
    data = train_data,
    syn_size = syn_size
  )

  model_list <- vector("list", length(approaches))
  for (app_i in seq_along(approaches)) {
    cat("\n\n", names(approaches)[app_i])

    model_input <- if (names(approaches)[app_i] == "MLE") {
      c(
        stand_input,
        approaches[[app_i]][[2]],
        list(
          family = gaussian,
          data = train_data
        )
      )
      # } else if (grepl("known", names(approaches)[app_i])) {
      #   c(
      #     stand_input,
      #     approaches[[app_i]][[2]],
      #     list(cat_init = cat_init_known_variance)
      #   )
    } else if (grepl("custom", names(approaches)[app_i])) {
      c(
        stand_input,
        approaches[[app_i]][[2]],
        list(cat_init = cat_init_custom_variance)
      )
    } else {
      c(
        stand_input,
        approaches[[app_i]][[2]],
        list(cat_init = cat_init)
      )
    }

    app_model <- do.call(approaches[[app_i]][[1]], model_input)
    model_list[[app_i]] <- app_model
    if (NA %in% coef(app_model)) {
      out_df[app_i, "MSE"] <- out_df[app_i, "SSE"] <- NA
    } else {
      out_df[app_i, "MSE"] <- as.numeric(mean(
        (predict(
          app_model,
          newdata = test_data
        ) - test_data[, data_Y_name])^2
      ))

      out_df[app_i, "SSE"] <- as.numeric(sum(
        (coef(app_model) - true_coefs)^2
      ))
    }
  }

  return(list(
    error_list = out_df,
    model_list = model_list
  ))
}

# data generation
linear_reg_data_generation <- function(n,
                                       n_test,
                                       p,
                                       X_name = "X",
                                       Y_name = "Y") {
  true_coefs <- rnorm(p)
  noise_sd <- runif(1, 0, 10)
  noise <- rnorm(n, 0, noise_sd)
  cat("\nnoise_sd:", noise_sd)
  train_x <- matrix(rnorm(n * (p - 1)), ncol = (p - 1))
  train_y <- true_coefs[1] + train_x %*% true_coefs[-1] + noise
  train_data <- as.data.frame(cbind(train_x, train_y))

  test_x <- matrix(rnorm(n_test * (p - 1)), ncol = (p - 1))
  test_y <- true_coefs[1] + test_x %*% true_coefs[-1]
  test_data <- as.data.frame(cbind(test_x, test_y))

  names(train_data) <- names(test_data) <- c(paste0(X_name, 1:(p - 1)), Y_name)
  return(list(
    true_sigma = noise_sd,
    train_data = train_data,
    test_data = test_data,
    true_coefs = true_coefs
  ))
}

library(xtable)

create_reminder <- function(task) {
  script <- sprintf("tell application \"Reminders\"
                       set newReminder to make new reminder with properties {name:\"%s\"}
                       tell newReminder
                           set due date to (current date) -- + (1 * minutes)
                       end tell
                     end tell", task)

  # Save the script temporarily
  writeLines(script, "CreateReminder.scpt")

  # Run the script
  system("osascript CreateReminder.scpt")

  # Remove the script after execution
  file.remove("CreateReminder.scpt")
}

create_row <- function(mean_, se_) {
  # Your existing function to create the desired row structure
  # This is just a placeholder function; replace with your actual implementation
  return(sprintf(
    "\\makecell{%.3f \\\\ \\small{(%.3f)}}",
    mean_,
    se_
  ))
}

create_linear_df_table <- function(all_error_list) {
  result_df <- vector("list", length(all_error_list))

  apps <- all_error_list[[1]][[1]]$Approaches

  for (tbls_i in seq_along(all_error_list)) {
    add_to_result_df <- data.frame(
      Approaches = apps,
      MSE_MEAN = numeric(length(apps)),
      MSE_SE = numeric(length(apps)),
      SSE_MEAN = numeric(length(apps)),
      SSE_SE = numeric(length(apps))
    )
    tbls <- all_error_list[[tbls_i]]

    for (i in seq_along(approaches)) {
      # Extract MSE and SSE for the current approach across all simulations
      mse_values <- sapply(tbls, function(df) df$MSE[i])
      sse_values <- sapply(tbls, function(df) df$SSE[i])
      # Calculate means and standard errors
      add_to_result_df$MSE_MEAN[i] <- mean(mse_values,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
      add_to_result_df$MSE_SE[i] <- sd(mse_values, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sim_times)

      add_to_result_df$SSE_MEAN[i] <- mean(sse_values,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
      add_to_result_df$SSE_SE[i] <- sd(sse_values, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sim_times)
    }
    result_df[[tbls_i]] <- add_to_result_df
  }
  return(result_df)
}

# Function to format a single row for LaTeX output
format_row_multiple <- function(df_list, index) {
  mse_means <- sapply(df_list, function(df) round(df$DEV_MEAN[index], 3))
  mse_ses <- sapply(df_list, function(df) round(df$DEV_SE[index], 3))
  sse_means <- sapply(df_list, function(df) round(df$SSE_MEAN[index], 3))
  sse_ses <- sapply(df_list, function(df) round(df$SSE_SE[index], 3))

  # Function to format numbers into scientific notation

  format_sci <- function(x) {
    if (is.nan(x) | is.na(x)) {
      return("-")
    } else if (abs(x) >= 1e10 || abs(x) < 1e-3) {
      base <- formatC(x, format = "e", digits = 3)
      base_parts <- strsplit(base, "e")[[1]]
      base_parts[2] <- sub("\\+", "", base_parts[2])
      return(paste0(
        "$",
        base_parts[1],
        " \\times 10^{",
        base_parts[2],
        "}$"
      ))
    } else {
      return(return(formatC(round(x, 3), format = "f", digits = 3)))
    }
  }

  # Apply the formatting function to each mean and standard error
  mse_means_formatted <- sapply(mse_means, format_sci)
  mse_ses_formatted <- sapply(mse_ses, format_sci)
  sse_means_formatted <- sapply(sse_means, format_sci)
  sse_ses_formatted <- sapply(sse_ses, format_sci)

  # Create one row for LaTeX combining values across dataframes for each approach
  paste0(
    "\\makecell{", df_list[[1]]$Approaches[index], "} & ",
    "\\makecell{", mse_means_formatted[1], " \\\\ \\small{(", mse_ses_formatted[1], ")}} & ",
    "\\makecell{", sse_means_formatted[1], " \\\\ \\small{(", sse_ses_formatted[1], ")}} & ",
    "\\makecell{", mse_means_formatted[2], " \\\\ \\small{(", mse_ses_formatted[2], ")}} & ",
    "\\makecell{", sse_means_formatted[2], " \\\\ \\small{(", sse_ses_formatted[2], ")}} & ",
    "\\makecell{", mse_means_formatted[3], " \\\\ \\small{(", mse_ses_formatted[3], ")}} & ",
    "\\makecell{", sse_means_formatted[3], " \\\\ \\small{(", sse_ses_formatted[3], ")}} \\\\ ",
    "\\addlinespace"
  )
}

# Function to format the entire table for all approaches
generate_latex_table_multiple <- function(df_list) {
  n <- nrow(df_list[[1]]) # Assuming all dataframes have the same number of rows
  latex_rows <- sapply(1:n, function(i) format_row_multiple(df_list, i))
  return(latex_rows)
}
```
